Faculty Profile

Dr. Sheng Chun Chang

ZSA Educator · Clinical Practice · Pharmacy, Neuroscience & Chinese Medicine

Dr. Sheng Chun Chang is a direct disciple of Professor Ming Qing Zhu and an international educator in Zhu’s Scalp Acupuncture. His multidisciplinary background spans Pharmacy, Neuroscience and Chinese Medicine. His teaching connects classical ZSA principles with biomedical, pharmacological and neurophysiological perspectives.
